adapter_provenance.method: Independent dispositions and dimension rationales copied unchanged; source paths bound to evidence IDs

reliability.rationale: All saved predictions and primary metrics independently reproduce from source-verified inputs, including unfavorable alternatives. Sixteen held plants support a small contemporaneous fluorescence descriptor gain, with paired uncertainty crossing zero. Ambiguous RWC and conflicting day annotations are excluded; no hydration forecasting or identified photosynthetic law follows.

novelty.rationale: This review checks computation and information access; targeted literature records are not independent priority adjudication.
